source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Avoid beverage alcohol, but alcohol-containing foods and medicines do not need to be checked.","B":"Avoid beverage alcohol and check foods, medicines, and topical products for hidden alcohol.","C":"Avoid alcohol only for 24 hours after the final disulfiram dose, then resume usual products.","D":"Avoid alcohol in foods, but alcohol-containing cough medicines and skin products are acceptable."}}
source_row.rationale: Disulfiram can react with alcohol from beverages and hidden sources, including some foods, medicines, and topical products; the reaction risk can persist for up to 14 days after the last dose. Option B is correct. A and D ignore hidden alcohol exposure, and C shortens the labeled risk period.
source_row.source_detail: Warnings/Precautions: avoid alcohol in disguised forms such as sauces, vinegars, cough mixtures, aftershave lotions and back rubs; alcohol-disulfiram reactions may occur up to 14 days after the last dose. DailyMed label updated 2025-04-07; current label live-rechecked 2026-08-15.
